articles.summary: Customers can support their local children’s hospital across participating network locations throughout November. Valvoline Inc. (NYSE: VVV), the quick, easy, trusted leader in preventive automotive maintenance , today kicked off its annual in-store fundraising campaign benefiting Children’s Miracle Network. Throughout November, customers at participating Valvoline Instant Oil Change, Great Canadian Oil Change, and Oil Changers locations can donate to support children and families in their local communities. This year marks Valvoline Inc.’s 17 th year supporting Children’s Miracle Network, a partnership that began in 2009. articles.title: Valvoline Inc. Kicks Off Annual Children’s Miracle Network® Fundraising Campaign

(NYSE: VVV), the quick, easy, trusted leader in preventive automotive maintenance , today announced that the company will be participating in a fireside chat at the Morgan Stanley Global Consumer Retail Conference on Wednesday, December 2, at 2:15 p.m. ET. A live audio webcast will be available on Valvoline Inc.’s investor relations website at http://investors.valvoline.com . Following the live event, an archived version of the webcast will be available on the website. About Valvoline Inc. Valvoline Inc. (NYSE: VVV) delivers quick, easy, trusted service at more than 2,500 franchised and company-operated service centers across the United States and Canada. The Company completes more than 33 million services annually system-wide, from about 15-minute stay-in-your-car oil changes to a variety of manufacturer-recommended maintenance services such as wiper replacements and tire rotations.
